ADB port-forward plus browser launch was rejected by automatic approval with reason blocked by policy; that action was not retried or counted as a passed emulator test.

PC and Android videos use actual final Web/IIFE interface still frames with transitions and Mandarin narration; Android is identified as a mobile layout demonstration, not a physical-device recording.
MSIX is an unsigned Microsoft Store upload package; it was not installed or submitted to Partner Center.
Linux installed application checks run under Xvfb on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04; physical printers and all display/driver environments are outside this verification.
